theorems.name: Submission.cbr_rlim_thin_band
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (C : Set (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (t δ : ℝ), MeasurableSet C → μ C < ∞ → ν C < ∞ → Continuous f → μ {x | f x = t} = 0 → 0 < δ → ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ μ (C ∩ {x | t - ε ≤ f x ∧ f x ≤ t}) < ENNReal.ofReal δ ∧ ν (C ∩ {x | t - ε < f x ∧ f x < t}) < ENNReal.ofReal δ
